scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --external:@autoforge/workflow-sdk --outfile=dist/index.js && node --input-type=module -e "import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'; import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; const workflow = JSON.parse(await readFile('workflow.json', 'utf8')); const code = await readFile(workflow.entryPath); const manifest = { ...workflow, codeSha256: createHash('sha256').update(code).digest('hex') }; const canonical = JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2) + '\n'; await Promise.all([writeFile('workflow.json', canonical), writeFile('manifest.json', canonical)]);"
